example.title: Antelope Creek Masonry Arch Bridge
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Antelope Creek Masonry Arch Bridge)

brief: WPA masonry arch of 1940 on a gravel county road: three semicircular arches of Post Rock limestone quarried locally, laid in an ashlar pattern mixing rusticated and smooth-faced blocks, smooth voussoirs with rusticated keystones, a course of smooth stone at road level, a low solid parapet with tall rusticated end posts, and flared wing walls. Pasture and crop land all round; a dated stone records the year.

traits.railing_detail: low solid parapet with tall rusticated end posts
traits.masonry: Post Rock limestone ashlar, rusticated and smooth
